module: SMTP submodule of the third-party Copas library: identical to LuaSocket's socket.smtp but with asynchronous Copas sockets. Defines copas.smtp; the constants PORT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, DOMAIN and TIMEZONE are redirected to socket.smtp when assigned, other reads fall back to socket.smtp.

send.desc: Sends an email like socket.smtp.send, using a Copas socket by default for mailt.create.

mailt.desc: LuaSocket message table (from, rcpt, source, server, ...)

returns.desc: Result of socket.smtp.send (1 or nil + error)
